title: mlx-tomo: parallel-, fan- and cone-beam X-ray projection and backprojection on Apple GPUs via Metal/MLX
description: Forward and backprojection operators for parallel-, fan- and cone-beam X-ray tomography on Apple silicon GPUs via Metal/MLX, with a TIGRE-compatible Python interface for supported operations. Siddon and interpolated forward projectors, FDK-weighted and matched backprojectors, projection along arbitrary user-supplied rays for DRR generation, and FDK/FBP reconstruction. Host-side geometry in float64 with a float32 GPU pipeline, validated against a float64 reference implementation and analytic phantoms. Research software; not validated for clinical or diagnostic use.
